title: English Conversation 30:  Speaking Too Fast
content: 1. to be ready for something: to be prepared for some thing or some event - We are ready for the storm. - He is ready for his presentation tomorrow. 2. to take notes: to write down the important things during a meeting, class, lecture, etc. - She takes a lot of notes during class. - Did you take notes during the meeting? 3. to write something down: to write something on paper - Write this down so you don't forget. - I always write down my ideas so I don't forget.
